free_resources.title: Mental Health Awareness Exercises
free_resources.description: A free series of guided prayer exercises for becoming still and bringing a particular mental health struggle before God, offered as comfort and companionship rather than advice.

free_resources.title: The Gift of Sleep
free_resources.description: A free bedtime Examen in the Ignatian tradition that hands memory, understanding and will over to God for the night, seeing sleep as a gift received rather than achieved. Set to quiet music.
